offering_description.value: ACM Research sells production equipment to integrated circuit and compound semiconductor manufacturers, advanced packaging companies, and wafer producers. It manufactures wafer and panel processing tools and develops customized wafer processes.

quotes.quote: ACM Research is a global, world-class wafer fabrication equipment (WFE) manufacturer serving IC and compound semiconductor, wafer-level packaging and panel-level packaging markets with a broad portfolio of products.

At ACM Research, we focus on developing unique single and batch wet wafer processes to address challenges in IC and compound semiconductor device manufacturing, wafer-level packaging, and wafer manufacturing and reclaim. Our high-performance, cost-effective processes can be customized across a multitude of manufacturing steps to help you improve your productivity and product yield.

primary_products.value: wet cleaning and processing equipment; electroplating equipment; stress-free polishing equipment; thermal processing and deposition equipment; wafer track equipment

quotes.quote: We develop, manufacture, and sell production equipment and provide service solutions for single-wafer or batch wet cleaning, electroplating, stress-free polishing, PECVD, track and thermal processes.

Our wide range of advanced product offerings support multiple semiconductor processing steps including single-wafer and batch wet cleaning, electroplating, thermal deposition, stress-free polishing, PECVD, ALD, and track equipment. ACMR delivers customized, high-performance, sustainable tool and process technology solutions that improve productivity, efficiency, and yield for high-volume manufacturing at low cost of ownership.
